descriptions.rgb: The scene is an indoor laboratory with a long dark-topped workbench running along the left side, a desk and rolling chair to the right in the initial frame, and background cabinetry with a doorway roughly 5 to 6 metres ahead. Two people wearing white lab coats stand close together (within 0.5 metres of each other) beside the left workbench, where white plastic racks, stacked cardboard and white boxes, a hotplate stirrer holding a glass beaker, and a red cylindrical container are arranged from front to back. In the first frame, the two people are about 3 to 3.5 metres in front of the camera wearer and face left toward the workbench, with the foreground person largely occluding the second person standing immediately behind and to her right. Across the five frames, the camera wearer walks forward along the bench, closing the distance to the foreground person from roughly 3.5 metres to about 0.8 metres while the racks, stacked boxes, and right-side desk pass behind and out of view at the bottom-left and right edges. As the camera wearer approaches, the foreground person turns her body and head rightward in frames 2 and 3 to face and look toward the camera wearer while holding her hands together at chest height, before angling her head slightly downward in frames 4 and 5 as the second person becomes partially visible behind her right shoulder at about 1.3 metres away. By the final two frames, the foreground person, the stacked white boxes, and the hotplate with the beaker on the bench to the left are all within arm's reach (under 1 metre) of both the camera wearer and the two lab-coated people, and the camera wearer's own hands appear at the bottom-right edge holding a small transparent object.
